meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页打磨得更美观、更规范,同时兼顾性能与无障碍。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常做前端界面调整,却不太确定设计是否好看。
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages to be more elegant, consistent, and accessible.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweak frontend interfaces but are unsure about design taste.

howto.what: 装上后，做前端、界面、视觉类任务时，Claude 会先读取技能附带的四套规则，建立或遵守 DESIGN.md 设计约定，再按参考实现组件、页面，并用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse 审计。
howto.when: 当提到 frontend、UI、React 等词，或要求做设计、改版、动效等前端任务时触发。

say.text: 从零做一个 Stripe 风格的落地页，先建 DESIGN.md 再写组件。
say.note: 会读取品牌参考并先形成设计约定。

say.text: 把这张 Figma 导出图实现成 React 页面，先提取 DESIGN.md。
say.note: 会先提取视觉规范再写代码，并做像素级核对。

howto.what_en: Once installed, for frontend/UI/visual work Claude reads the skill's four bundled rulesets, creates/follows a DESIGN.md contract, implements components/pages against it, and runs Lighthouse audits in a real browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention frontend, UI, React, or ask to design, redesign, or animate something.

say_en.text: Build a Stripe-style landing page: DESIGN.md first, then components.
say_en.note: Reads the brand ref and sets the design contract.

say_en.text: Turn this Figma export into a React page; extract DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Extracts the visual spec, implements, and checks pixels.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit in Chromium; mobile and desktop should both hit 100.
say_en.note: Drives real Chromium via Playwright to measure.
